name: Kipperlyn Sinclair
occupation: Hillsboro City Councilor; Founder/Director, Eat Drink Washington County

bio.statement: Sinclair's pamphlet statement lists her occupation as Hillsboro city councilor and founder/director of Eat Drink Washington County.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Hillsboro City Councilor, Founder/Director, Eat Drink Washington County.

bio.statement: Sinclair's pamphlet statement lists eight years of civic leadership and owning a specialty food business.
bio.excerpt: Eight years civic leadership; Specialty food business owner.

bio.statement: Sinclair's pamphlet statement lists service as a Hillsboro city councilor and president of the Hillsboro Transportation Committee.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Hillsboro City Councilor; President, Hillsboro Transportation Committee;

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Sinclair calls for ending data center tax breaks and halting expansion onto farmland.
positions.excerpt: Stop Sprawl & Protect Prime Soil: End data center tax breaks; halt expansion onto farmland.

positions.statement: Sinclair's pamphlet statement supports independent businesses, transit-oriented growth and farm-to-market hubs.
positions.excerpt: Back independent businesses and transit-oriented growth, opening farm-to-market hubs

positions.statement: Sinclair's pamphlet statement says she will uphold due process, safeguard privacy from surveillance and protect public data.
positions.excerpt: I will uphold due process, safeguard privacy from surveillance, protect public data,

positions.statement: Sinclair's pamphlet statement says corporations should pay their fair share and fund schools.
positions.excerpt: Require corporations to pay their fair share and fund schools.

positions.statement: Sinclair's campaign site says she will push to activate economic improvement districts along Main Streets.
positions.excerpt: I will push to activate Economic Improvement Districts along our Main Streets

positions.statement: In a 2026 OPB article, Sinclair describes data center tax breaks as public dollars being given away to corporations.
positions.excerpt: What I want people to understand: these are your public dollars being given away to corporations.

positions.statement: In a May 2026 KPTV report, Sinclair says the enterprise zone approach is intended for long-term local creation of high-wage jobs.
positions.excerpt: The enterprise zone methodology is intended for local job creation, long term with high wage jobs.

gaps: OPB reported she did not respond to its May 2026 candidate questionnaire
No official Hillsboro council bio page could be fetched
collection_notes: County board page lists Jerry Willey as Vice Chair and District 4 Commissioner, so neither runoff candidate is the incumbent. Hillsboro city news pages (hillsboro-oregon.gov/Home/Components/News/...) returned client errors and the Hillsboro 101 page has no named roster, so city-office facts come from the pamphlet and press. Campaign domain printed in the county pamphlet statement. Pamphlet quotes capped ~125 chars by the fetch tool.
